name: Merchant to Travelers
description:
You've seen the merchants of Upham charge high prices to travelers who are happy to pay them.

Whenever you encounter travelers outside of cities and towns, you may attempt to sell some of your provisions to them for profit. Roll Awe, Perform or Persuade against a difficulty equal to 10 plus the travelers' current Keeping. On a pass, you gain 1d4 Treasure.

Describe how you make the deal.
successes:
🌞: They are desperate for provisions. On a pass, you gain 1d10 Treasure. On a failure, you gain 1 Treasure.

💀: You make a bad deal. Pass or fail, you gain 1 Treasure and lower the Quest's Keeping by 1 tier.
